title: China's 5-Minute EV Charge Is Real (Almost) #shorts
description:
BYD's Super e-Platform (March 2025) claims 1,000 kW charging: about 400 km of range in 5 minutes. Here's how it compares, and the catch.

New China Short every day; full reality-show recap every Saturday. Subscribe to @mainlandunpacked.

Sources: BYD press release (17 Mar 2025); Inside China Auto. Charging figures are BYD's own claims. Footage: Vincent Everts (CC BY).

scenes.text: China just made charging an EV almost as fast as filling up with gas.
headline: 5-MINUTE
EV CHARGE

scenes.text: In March 2025, BYD unveiled chargers that push one thousand kilowatts. That's a full megawatt.
scenes.label: peak charging power

scenes.text: BYD says five minutes on the plug adds about four hundred kilometers of range.
The previous record was about 520 kilowatts. A standard Tesla Supercharger peaks at 250.
The catch: you need BYD's own megawatt chargers, and it plans to build more than four thousand across China.
scenes.label: 4,000+ stations planned

scenes.text: Would you switch to an EV if charging took five minutes? Tell me in the comments.
scenes.question: WOULD YOU SWITCH?
